name: recast
title: Recast
description: Rewrite selected text with Claude on Amazon Bedrock. Supports tone presets and custom instructions.
author: martin_sakowski

commands.name: rewrite-selected
commands.title: Rewrite Selected Text
commands.description: Rewrite the currently selected text with the default tone

commands.name: rewrite-with-tone
commands.title: Rewrite with Tone
commands.description: Choose a tone preset then rewrite the selected text

commands.name: rewrite-with-instruction
commands.title: Rewrite with Custom Instruction
commands.description: Provide a custom rewrite instruction for the selected text

preferences.name: credentialMethod
preferences.title: Credential Method
preferences.description: How to obtain AWS credentials. 'Profile' uses a named AWS CLI profile. 'Environment' uses AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY env vars. 'Default' uses the AWS SDK default credential chain (env → profile → SSO → instance role).

preferences.name: awsProfile
preferences.title: AWS Profile
preferences.description: AWS CLI profile name. Only used when Credential Method is set to 'Named Profile'.

preferences.name: awsRegion
preferences.title: AWS Region
preferences.description: AWS region for Bedrock runtime (e.g. us-east-1, eu-central-1)

preferences.name: modelId
preferences.title: Model ID
preferences.description: Base Bedrock model ID, without an inference profile prefix (e.g. anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5). The prefix comes from the Inference Profile setting.

preferences.name: inferenceProfile
preferences.title: Inference Profile
preferences.description: Cross-Region inference profile used to call the model. Global routes to any supported commercial Region; a geography keeps requests within that area. 'None' invokes the model in your AWS Region directly (not supported by Claude Haiku 5.5).

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: Maximum tokens for the Bedrock response

preferences.name: temperature
preferences.title: Temperature
preferences.description: Optional model temperature (0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = creative). Leave empty for the model default. Claude Haiku 5.5 does not accept a temperature; leave it empty for that model.

preferences.name: defaultTone
preferences.title: Default Tone
preferences.description: Tone to use when no tone is specified
